description: Self-hosted governed browser automation provider evaluated behind the VAOS Automation & Integration Fabric.

licensing.model: Open-source browser automation runtime; browser binaries and deployment posture require qualification.
licensing.notes: Authenticated browser state is treated as secret material and must not be committed or returned as VAOS evidence.

notes: Initial AF-6 scope requires origin allow-listing, isolated execution, sealed trace/evidence references, downloads disabled by default, and no blind retry after a task may have caused an external side effect.
